description.text: Program introduction The International class on Media and Communications is particularly designed for international undergraduate students. All courses are taught in English. This program aims to qualify students with theoretical knowledge and professional skills on media and communications and enable students to have broad international vision and comprehensive knowledge on policies and regulations related to media and communications as well as enterprising and innovative spirits. Main Courses All specialized compulsory courses and elective courses are taught in English, using English textbooks. The submitted course work and thesis should be written in English and provided with Chinese-English summary. Professional core courses: Journalism, Broadcasting Theory, Advertising, Mass Communication Research, Public Relations, Media Ethics and Regulations, Media Research Methods, Digital Technology Approaches, etc.

duration.text: The Media and communication at Wuhan University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3. High school academic transcript 4. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English

requirements.text: 1.High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2.With an excellent command over English Language, with essential B or above. 3.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport, above the age of 18 and under the age of 30.
